basic_info.description: Artfully designed by Fougeron Architects, 400 Grove manages to blend in while standing out! Located in the vibrant heart of Hayes Valley, you'll find superb proximity to shopping, dining and the performing arts.  Home #209 is tucked into a quiet corner of the building where a lush bamboo grove affords privacy while western exposure warms the primary suite with natural light. High-quality finishes have been further elevated with the thoughtful additions of a granite-topped kitchen island, wine fridge, LED "wave" pendant light, custom closets & vanity shelving plus remote-controlled Hunter Douglas blinds throughout. Beautiful wide plank flooring, embedded accent lighting, Siematic cabinetry and Bosch laundry & kitchen appliances combine to create a home that is not only sleek & modern, but functional & comfortable.  The open & bright primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet, luxe bath & study nook. The guest room overlooks the verdant courtyard and doubles as a WFH space, study or media room. The community includes secure bike storage for all residents in the garage. Topping it all off is a lovely shared roof deck with panoramic city views, gas fire pit, comfortable seating and community barbecue.      Live your urban dream at 400 Grove!
